about.description: <highlight>Waai</highlight> is an educational platform dedicated to teaching the Holy Quran and reading for children and youth. It provides a comprehensive and systematic curriculum by qualified teachers via distance learning. <highlight>Waai</highlight> aims to provide high-quality education and interaction with the Quran and reading in innovative and modern ways.
about.featuresTitle: Among the prominent features of <highlight>Waai</highlight> platform

goalsContent.title: Drawing closer to Allah through Quran recitation:
goalsContent.desc: We teach students how to recite the Quran in a correct and beautiful manner, encouraging them to read and contemplate the Quran to strengthen their connection with Allah.

goalsContent.title: Education through the Quran:
goalsContent.desc: We don't stop at memorization, but focus on extracting Quranic values and morals to apply them in daily life as a way of living.

goalsContent.title: Quality control and guidance system for teachers:
goalsContent.desc: We rely on a strict quality control system to ensure our teachers provide education with the highest standards of quality and follow-up.

goalsContent.title: Interaction and Innovation:
goalsContent.desc: Using the latest interactive methods and educational games to make the learning journey interesting and free of boredom.

goalsContent.title: Flexibility and Continuous Support:
goalsContent.desc: Providing flexible education that suits everyone's schedule, while maintaining the highest quality standards, continuous follow-up, and permanent support for students.

mechanismContent.title: Direct and Interactive Sessions:
mechanismContent.desc: Live online sessions via secure visual platforms ensure direct interaction between the student and the teacher to break the spatial barrier.

mechanismContent.title: Personal Follow-up (1-on-1):
mechanismContent.desc: We provide individual paths that meet the needs of each student and focus on their weak points to strengthen them with a customized plan suitable for their learning speed.

mechanismContent.title: Interactive Group Sessions:
mechanismContent.desc: We offer educational sessions gathering the teacher with multiple students simultaneously to promote the spirit of participation and positive competition among students.

mechanismContent.title: Continuous Evaluation and Periodic Reports:
mechanismContent.desc: Sending periodic reports to parents showing the student's progress, commitment to the educational plan, and continuous development.

mechanismContent.title: Flexible Timings:
mechanismContent.desc: Flexible schedules suiting different student timings worldwide to facilitate the learning process.

visionContent: At Waai Academy, we believe that faith before the Quran is the key to understanding and reciting the Quran correctly and effectively.
We aim to build a committed and believing generation that memorizes the Quran and lives its great values in their daily lives.

We draw our inspiration from the word of Allah in the Quran:
“Certainly did Allah confer [great] favor upon the believers when He sent among them a Messenger from themselves, reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book and wisdom” (Al Imran: 164).
We aim to achieve these goals and more with the help of Allah.
Finally, we always strive to be a place where students benefit from memorizing and learning the Quran deeply and distinctively.
We thank Allah for this opportunity and hope to continue serving the Quran and teaching it to future generations to build Muslims with a firm identity and belief.

islamic_education.title: Islamic Education (Kids)
islamic_education.desc: Do you want to teach your children Islamic values and ethics in a fun and beneficial way? The Islamic Education course for kids at 'Waai Academy' offers you the perfect opportunity. We aim to enhance Islamic education combining knowledge and fun.

tajweed_adults.title: Tajweed Course for Adults
tajweed_adults.desc: If you are looking for a deeper understanding and better Tajweed for reciting the Holy Quran, the Tajweed course at 'Waai Academy' is your perfect choice. We offer distinguished Tajweed courses to master the rules of recitation.

quran_non_arabic.title: Quran for Non-Arabic Speakers
quran_non_arabic.desc: Do you want to understand and recite the Holy Quran as a non-Arabic speaker? The Quran course for non-Arabic speakers at Waai Academy is your ideal choice. Specially designed courses to help you recite correctly.

quran_memorization.title: Holy Quran Memorization
quran_memorization.desc: At Waai Academy, we aim to provide a unique online Quran memorization experience. Our memorization courses come with many advantages that make the process easier and more enjoyable.

curriculum.title: Comprehensive Curriculum
curriculum.desc: We don't focus only on abstract memorization, but deeply care about understanding meanings and practical application in daily life so their character becomes the Quran.

teachers.title: Specialized Teachers
teachers.desc: An elite group of male and female teachers with long experience not only in Tajweed, but in the arts of education and psychological interaction with children and youth.

flexible.title: Flexible Online Learning
flexible.desc: Modern educational technologies allow students to learn from anywhere in the world, with interactive tools that break the barrier of boredom and make the session fun.

followup.title: Accurate Personal Follow-up
followup.desc: Every student is a special case; having a plan that suits their abilities and monthly reports informing parents of the finest details of progress.

t1.name: Um Mohammed
t1.comment: My son has become more committed and loving to the Quran after joining the academy. The follow-up is great and constantly motivates the student.

t2.name: Ahmed Khaled
t2.comment: What I liked most is combining memorization with understanding meanings in a practical and simple way. The teachers here are truly wonderful.

t3.name: Sara Ali
t3.comment: A very special experience, the teachers are cooperative and the educational environment is motivating and comfortable for the child. Highly recommended.
